title: 打印文本
problem_statement_md:
在给定代码中，完善函数`printSentence`，打印"继续学习"。

并从`main()`函数中调用它。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Introduction to functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 
Complete the function in order to print the sentence [b]"Keep learning!"[/b] and call it from main() function.

[b]Output[/b]
Keep learning!

[note]Remember that the function declaration must be placed before the caller code.[/note]
hint_md: 记住，函数声明必须放在调用者代码之前。
